notes.content:
Welcome to the world of Bunny Battle Arena. 

[h1]A tale of love, gore and cute little bunnies!!![/h1]

Meet Yasmin, a warrior with a pure heart, but in love with Death, possessed by it and host of Reaper's powers at the Bunny Kingdom. Their bond of Love created Maiden, a Super Powerful Warrior, who seeks only the destruction off those SO CUTE little bunnies! 


We from DCF Studios, hope you enjoy the experience of slicing and dicing, beheading, burning, electrifying, pulverize, and other fun "TO DOS", at those little bunny bastards! [b]That are so cutty CUTE!!![/b]


And Do not forget, about the book of rules:

[h1]THE 7 HABITS OF HIGHLY EFFECTIVE MAIDENS[/h1]

[b]HABIT NUMERO DOS[/b]: We only Do it after a hot cup of coffee! 


Have fun!
[b]DCF Studios[/b]
